description: This file defines a Swift extension on the View protocol that adds a layout modifier method called settingsSidebarCardLayout(). The method applies a specific frame size, background shape, fill color, and clipping to views, intended for a sidebar card component in a MacOS app.

methods.name: settingsSidebarCardLayout
methods.description: A modifier method that applies layout, background, and shape styling to a SwiftUI view for sidebar cards.
